description: 2-block hand-built keyword decision list: 20 Gaussian copy heads + ~400 exact AND-gate keyword neurons; '=' attends to max 300*priority-3*pos and copies the class vote; default ENTY.
v2: one AND-gate neuron per keyword (left word edge = boundary OR start flag), ~400 keywords from general knowledge; '=' attends to max 300*prio-3*pos, copies vote; default ENTY.
v3: v2 minus co-firing/over-broad keywords (proper nouns, mass, square, old...), short 'what is' gate moved off word-end positions; decision list by 300*prio-3*pos; default ENTY.
v4: v3 with question-initial 'who' as a stem (who/whom/whose); 20 Gaussian copy heads, ~580 AND-gate keyword neurons, '=' picks max 300*prio-3*pos and copies its vote; default ENTY.
